environment.resource_provenance: emitted circuits, lowered to {1q, CX} and routed

gates.name: C2_flagged_composition
gates.criterion: coherent-flag QFIM == branch average in the zero-mean sector; F_Psi == sum p_r F_r + Cov(mu_r) in general; the two differ on the control
gates.notes: The control has zero branch QFIM but a rank-one program QFIM; a backend that reports sum_r p_r F_r there is wrong by the whole matrix.

gates.name: C2c_flag_coherence_discriminator
gates.criterion: dephasing the flag separates labelled-equivalent programs from genuinely coherent ones; conditional branch width is only a resource for the former
gates.notes: Programs on opposite sides of this test are not comparable on gate count. A cheaper coherent program that fails dephasing has not compiled the same object.

gates.name: C3_exact_feasibility
gates.criterion: full-vertex LP, column generation with exact pricing, and certificate search agree on a suite containing feasible, infeasible and boundary targets
gates.notes: Both outcomes must occur, else the gate never exercises rejection.

gates.name: C4_infeasible_rejection
gates.criterion: every certified-infeasible target is rejected AND the emitted certificate independently verifies
gates.notes: Reference instance: m=3, all off-diagonals -0.4. Spectrum {0.2, 1.4, 1.4} (positive definite, unit diagonal) but b=(1,1,1) gives b^T F b = 0.6 < 1.

gates.name: C6_width_integrity
gates.criterion: every emitted branch factorises across its declared blocks and no declared width exceeds the compiled width

gates.name: C7_Clifford_mapping
gates.criterion: QFIM realised in the physical generator frame matches the target after simultaneous diagonalisation
gates.notes: Width is measured in both frames: a width-k Z-frame branch is generically a globally entangled physical state, so minimum-entanglement language is frame-relative and must be stated as such.

gates.name: C8_hardware_legality
gates.criterion: every two-qubit gate uses a legal edge after routing

gates.name: C9_resource_accounting
gates.criterion: lowered circuits are unitarily equivalent to the emitted circuits and every count is a recount of the instruction list

gates.name: C10_downstream_stability
gates.criterion: tightness of ||A^T dF A|| <= ||A||^2 ||dF||, reported with CRB conditioning
gates.notes: The inequality is submultiplicativity and holds for every matrix, so it is not a test. What governs precision is the conditioning of F^{-1} on the estimable subspace; the polytope's extreme points are rank one, i.e. maximally ill-conditioned.

gates.name: C11_sld_saturability
gates.criterion: mean Uhlmann curvature vanishes: max_ij |Im <psi|P_i P_j|psi>| < 1e-12
gates.notes: Im <d_i psi|d_j psi> = -(1/4) Im <psi|P_i P_j|psi>, which vanishes identically for commuting Hermitian generators. Without this the multiparameter Cramer-Rao bound is not attainable and no 'certified downstream performance' claim is licensed.

gates.name: C12_convexity_gap
gates.criterion: F(unlabelled rho) <= sum_r p_r F_r, with the gap reported per schedule shape
gates.notes: If the gap is zero for global cat schedules, the forbidden shortcut is not a shortcut there: orthogonal branches make the label free. The labelled/coherent distinction has to earn its section in the bounded-width regime, where the branches overlap.
